full_judgment: 2. The accused-petitioners have been implicated in Panchlish Police Station Case No. 15 dated 11-4-1998 under sections 143/448/385 and 380 of the Penal Code and the police upon investigation submitted charge sheet on 28-5-1998 against the accused-petitioners and accordingly, the said case has been registered as GR Case No. 949 of 1998 before the Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Chittagong. Thereafter, on transfer, the said case has been registered as ST Case No. 707 of 1999 and the trial has been commenced before the Metropolitan Sessions Judge, 2nd Court, Chittagong after framing of the charge at the trial of ST Case No. 707 of 1999. PWs 1, 2 and 5 have been examined and cross-examined by the accused-petitioners. Thereafter, on 23-4-2000, the accused-petitioner filed an application under section 540 of the Code of Criminal Procedure praying for recall of the PW 1 informant Deli Pal, on the ground stated in the application. The learned Metropolitan Sessions Judge, 2nd Court, Chittagong rejected the said prayer on the reasoning that no cogent grounds have been mentioned in the petition for recall of the PW 1 for re-examination.
